activity.mutatesWithArgs: This tool changes content. Here are the arguments:
activity.confirmTool: This step runs only after you confirm.
activity.remember: Don’t ask about {{tool}} again in this chat
activity.timeout_one: Denied automatically if no answer within 1 minute
activity.timeout_other: Denied automatically if no answer within {{count}} minutes

notInstalled.title: Chat engine not found
notInstalled.detail: You can download it in settings.

config.title: Chat model unavailable
config.detail: No chat model is set up yet.

processExit.title: Chat engine quit unexpectedly
processExit.detail: It will restart automatically the next time you send.

runtime.thinkingFollow: Later replies follow the model’s thinking level ({{label}})
runtime.busy: The previous reply hasn’t finished. Wait for it to end or stop generating before sending.

messages.renderFailed: This message can’t be displayed. Other messages aren’t affected.
messages.emptyText: Cite an article from Focus, or just ask a question.

meter.limitUnknown: The context limit isn’t known yet; it will appear after the chat engine has started once.
meter.limitUser: Limit {{limit}} is the context length you set for {{model}} in settings.
meter.limitEngine: Limit {{limit}} is the default the chat engine reports for {{model}} (left blank in settings).
meter.limitLast: Limit {{limit}} is based on the model used when you last sent a message.
meter.noteUsage: Context used by this chat at the end of the last turn.
meter.noteNoRecord: This chat has no usage recorded yet; it will appear after you send a message.
meter.warnNear: You’re near the limit: the chat engine compresses earlier content automatically, so details may be lost. If you need the full context, start a new chat and cite the key points from this one.
meter.warnSoon: You’re approaching the limit: the chat engine compresses earlier content automatically, so details may be lost. If you need the full context, start a new chat and cite the key points from this one.

chip.renameBusy: Another model setting is being saved. Try again shortly.
chip.noReasoning: {{model}} doesn’t support reasoning, so replies won’t use thinking.
chip.hintDefault: {{model}} defaults to {{level}}; changes here only affect this chat.
chip.hintOwn: The default comes from your Pi configuration; changes here only affect this chat.
chip.hintNoDefault: If {{model}} has no default level, its own default applies; changes here only affect this chat.
chip.hintSnap: Levels the model doesn’t support are switched to the closest one.

composer.otherBusy: Another chat is replying. Wait for it to finish or stop generating.

picker.renameHint: Press Enter to save; leave blank to use the short name · {{name}}

titles.confirm: Generate a chat title with AI?
titles.message: RRSS sends up to two short question excerpts to {{model}}. Your provider may charge for this. A successful result replaces the current title, including one you wrote yourself.
titles.noModel: Choose a title model before generating a title.
titles.failed: Couldn’t generate a title. The current title was kept.

outcome.busy: A title is already being generated.
outcome.no_questions: Write a question before generating a title.
outcome.model_changed: The title model changed. Confirm again to use the new model.
outcome.invalid: The model returned an invalid title. The current title was kept.

placeholder.autoTitle: Leave blank to use the automatic title

notice.deletedFolderWithThreads: Deleted folder “{{name}}”; its chats are now outside any folder

confirm.noteThread: Messages and the Pi chat record are deleted too; this can’t be undone. If you just want it out of the sidebar, archive it instead.
confirm.noteThreads_one: Its chat will be moved out of the folder, not deleted.
confirm.noteThreads_other: Its {{count}} chats will be moved out of the folder, not deleted.

archivedView.note: Archived chats are hidden from the sidebar and search. Sending a new message after opening one unarchives it automatically.
